weapons.name: Bee Keeper
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Bee
weapons.why: Dropped by Queen Bee; summons bees on hit and inflicts Confused.

weapons.name: Slime Spear
weapons.source: Crafted from 50 Gel at a Solidifier (Solidifier dropped by King Slime)
weapons.why: Crafted at a Solidifier, first obtainable via King Slime's drop.

weapons.name: Code 1
weapons.source: Bought from the Traveling Merchant after the Eye of Cthulhu is defeated
weapons.why: Traveling Merchant yoyo unlocked once the Eye of Cthulhu is beaten.

weapons.name: Hive-Five
weapons.source: Crafted (14 Bee Wax at an Iron/Lead Anvil); Bee Wax drops from Queen Bee
weapons.why: Crafted from Queen Bee's Bee Wax and releases homing bee projectiles.

weapons.name: Flamarang
weapons.source: Crafted at an Anvil from Enchanted Boomerang and 15 Hellstone Bars
weapons.why: Hellstone-tier boomerang that inflicts On Fire.

weapons.name: Volcano
weapons.source: Crafted (Hellstone Bars)
weapons.why: Crafted from Hellstone Bars; creates an explosion on hitting enemies.

weapons.name: Phaseblades
weapons.source: Crafted (15 Meteorite Bars + 15 gems, at an Anvil)
weapons.why: Group of nine identical broadswords; can be thrown while swinging.

weapons.name: Stylish Scissors
weapons.source: Dropped by the Stylist
weapons.why: Dropped by the Stylist; inflicts Bleeding.

weapons.name: Blade of Grass
weapons.source: Crafted (Jungle Spores + Stingers)
weapons.why: Fires a homing Leaf Blade projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Amazon
weapons.source: Crafted (8 Rich Mahogany + 12 Stinger + Vine + 9 Jungle Spores at an Iron/Lead Anvil)
weapons.why: Strongest yoyo craftable before any boss, from Jungle materials.

weapons.name: Starfury
weapons.source: Found in Skyware Chests (Floating Islands)
weapons.why: Calls a falling star from the sky on each swing.

weapons.name: Ball O' Hurt
weapons.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt/Defiled Crates
weapons.why: Corruption flail obtained by breaking Shadow Orbs, needs no boss.

weapons.name: Thorn Chakram
weapons.source: Crafted at an Anvil from Jungle Spores and Stingers
weapons.why: Bouncing Jungle-crafted chakram that inflicts Poisoned.

armor.name: Shadow Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Demonite Bars and Shadow Scales
armor.why: Corruption worlds only. Increased movement speed and acceleration.

armor.name: Crimson Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Crimtane Bars and Tissue Samples
armor.why: Crimson worlds only. Greatly increased life regeneration, so it is the tankier of the two.

accessories.name: Obsidian Skull
accessories.why: Fire-block immunity for Hellstone runs. Obsidian Shield needs a Cobalt Shield, which is Dungeon loot.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.why: Combines sprinting boots with Rocket Boots, so you can run fast and fly briefly.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
accessories.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.

accessories.name: Band of Regeneration
accessories.why: The passive healing is small on paper but adds up fast when paired with campfires and heart lanterns.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: It stays the most universal and reliable early combat buff for melee.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.why: More movement speed means more uptime and fewer mistakes during boss fights.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: It smooths out incoming damage during long arena fights and exploration loops.

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.why: The armor penetration bonus is one of the best class-specific pre-Hardmode melee boosts.

buffs.name: Ale
buffs.why: Tipsy: more melee damage and crit for less defense.

buffs.name: Sake
buffs.why: Longer-lasting Tipsy than Ale.

buffs.name: Flask of Poison
buffs.source: Brewed at an Imbuing Station (Bottled Water + Stinger)
buffs.why: Coats melee hits with the Poisoned debuff.

weapons.name: Demon Bow
weapons.source: Crafted from Demonite Bars and Shadow Scales (Eater of Worlds)
weapons.why: Corruption bow requiring Shadow Scales dropped by the Eater of Worlds.

weapons.name: The Bee's Knees
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Bee
weapons.why: Converts wooden arrows into homing bees.

weapons.name: Pew-matic Horn
weapons.source: Dropped by Deerclops
weapons.why: Gun that fires random-color projectiles, dropped by the Deerclops boss.

weapons.name: Beenade
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Bee; crafted with Bee Wax from Queen Bee
weapons.why: A Queen Bee consumable that releases homing bees on detonation.

weapons.name: Molten Fury
weapons.source: Crafted from Hellstone Bars
weapons.why: Hellstone-tier bow that ignites the arrows it fires.

weapons.name: Star Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted (Minishark + 20 Meteorite Bars + 5 Fallen Stars)
weapons.why: Fires Fallen Stars for high damage, limited by how many stars you have collected.

weapons.name: Boomstick
weapons.source: Found in Ivy Chests and Jungle/Bramble Crates
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode shotgun that fires a spread of bullets, found in the Jungle.

weapons.name: Tendon Bow
weapons.source: Crafted from Crimtane Bars
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart to the Demon Bow, crafted from Crimtane Bars.

weapons.name: Grenade
weapons.source: Purchased from the Demolitionist; found rarely in Chests
weapons.why: An explosive consumable bought from the Demolitionist that detonates shortly after being thrown.

armor.name: Shadow Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Demonite Bars and Shadow Scales
armor.why: Corruption worlds only. Increased movement speed and acceleration.

armor.name: Crimson Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Crimtane Bars and Tissue Samples
armor.why: Crimson worlds only. Greatly increased life regeneration, so it is the tankier of the two.

accessories.name: Obsidian Skull
accessories.why: Fire-block immunity for Hellstone runs. Obsidian Shield needs a Cobalt Shield, which is Dungeon loot.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.why: Combines sprinting boots with Rocket Boots, so you can run fast and fly briefly.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.

accessories.name: Lucky Horseshoe
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests and Sky Crates
accessories.why: It lets you use height aggressively for kiting without losing runs to fall damage.

accessories.name: Band of Regeneration
accessories.why: The passive healing is small on paper but adds up fast when paired with campfires and heart lanterns.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: More defense gives you room to play imperfectly while still keeping ranged uptime.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.why: It helps kiting, arena recovery, and general boss consistency.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly on the strongest guns, so this stretches your best supplies further.

weapons.name: Bee Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Bee (1/3 chance)
weapons.why: Fires several homing bee projectiles per shot.

weapons.name: Weather Pain
weapons.source: Dropped by Deerclops
weapons.why: Fires a slow weather-front projectile that spawns damaging effects.

weapons.name: Gray Zapinator
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant (pre-Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam that ricochets and varies in size.

weapons.name: Ruby Staff
weapons.source: Crafted (10 Gold Bars + 8 Ruby)
weapons.why: Gem staff firing a ruby bolt.

weapons.name: Diamond Staff
weapons.source: Crafted (10 Platinum Bars + 8 Diamond)
weapons.why: Strongest gem staff, firing a fast diamond bolt.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts (1/5), or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.

weapons.name: Amber Staff
weapons.source: Crafted (15 Sturdy Fossil + 8 Amber)
weapons.why: Fossil-crafted gem staff whose amber bolt travels faster than other gem staves.

weapons.name: Space Gun
weapons.source: Crafted from 20 Meteorite Bars at an anvil (Meteorite spawns after breaking a Shadow Orb/Crimson Heart)
weapons.why: Rapidly fires fast-moving lasers and costs no mana with Meteor armor.

armor.name: Meteor Armor
armor.why: Space Gun costs 0 mana, so it pairs with that weapon specifically.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.why: Auto-using mana potions makes mage much easier to pilot and keeps your attention on dodging.

accessories.name: Magic Cuffs
accessories.why: The max mana and on-hit mana return are both excellent on longer fights.

accessories.name: Obsidian Skull
accessories.why: Fire-block immunity for Hellstone runs. Obsidian Shield needs a Cobalt Shield, which is Dungeon loot.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.why: Combines sprinting boots with Rocket Boots, so you can run fast and fly briefly.

accessories.name: Band of Starpower
accessories.source: Found in Shadow Orbs / Crimson Hearts
accessories.why: +20 max mana for early casters.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.why: Raises magic damage by 20%.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Even mages need some room for mistakes, and defense is the easiest way to buy it.

buffs.name: Lesser Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted from Fallen Stars and Bottled Water
buffs.why: You still want a large stack ready for sustained arena or underworld attempts.

buffs.name: Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted, or found in most Crates
buffs.why: Restores 100 mana; causes Mana Sickness.

weapons.name: Hornet Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 14 Bee Wax at an Iron/Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons a Hornet minion that inflicts Poisoned; Bee Wax drops from Queen Bee.

weapons.name: Ballista Rod
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep for Defender Medals (tier 1)
weapons.why: Tier 1 Tavernkeep sentry that fires high-damage piercing bolts.

weapons.name: Houndius Shootius
weapons.source: Dropped by Deerclops
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode sentry dropped by Deerclops that shoots piercing fireballs.

weapons.name: Mushroom Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 300 Glowing Mushrooms + 5 Mushroom Grass Seeds + 5 Shadow Scales/Tissue Samples at an Iron/Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons a Mushroom Boi minion; requires an evil-boss drop (Shadow Scale or Tissue Sample) to craft.

weapons.name: Explosive Trap Rod
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep for Defender Medals (tier 1)
weapons.why: Tier 1 Tavernkeep sentry that lays a trap detonating when enemies pass over it.

weapons.name: Flameburst Rod
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep for Defender Medals (tier 1)
weapons.why: Tier 1 Tavernkeep sentry that fires explosive fireballs at ground enemies.

weapons.name: Lightning Aura Rod
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep for Defender Medals (tier 1)
weapons.why: Tier 1 Tavernkeep sentry summoning a stationary lightning aura ring.

weapons.name: Slime Whip
weapons.source: Crafted (50 Gel at a Solidifier, which is dropped by King Slime)
weapons.why: Crafted at the King Slime-dropped Solidifier and inflicts a slowing debuff on hit.

weapons.name: Imp Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 17 Hellstone Bars at an Iron/Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons an Imp minion that fires On Fire! bolts; needs Underworld Hellstone.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted (15 Stinger + 3 Vine + 12 Jungle Spores at an Anvil)
weapons.why: Jungle-material whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.

weapons.name: Flinx Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 6 Flinx Fur + 10 Gold/Platinum Bars at a Work Bench
weapons.why: Summons a Flinx minion; Flinx Fur drops from Snow Flinxes in the Snow biome.

weapons.name: Vampire Frog Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Zombie Merman and Wandering Eye Fish (Blood Moon)
weapons.why: Summons a Vampire Frog minion; obtainable during a Blood Moon with no boss required.

weapons.name: Starcrash
weapons.source: Crafted (20 Meteorite Bar + 10 Chain + 10 Fallen Star at an Anvil)
weapons.why: Summons falling star projectiles on hit that deal extra damage.

armor.name: Obsidian Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Obsidian, Shadow Scales or Tissue Samples, and Silk
armor.why: Whip range +30%, whip speed +15%, summon damage +15%.

armor.name: Bee Armor
armor.why: Summon damage +10%. Less defense than Obsidian, and no whip bonus.

accessories.name: Obsidian Skull
accessories.why: Fire-block immunity for Hellstone runs. Obsidian Shield needs a Cobalt Shield, which is Dungeon loot.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.why: +1 minion slot.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.why: Combines sprinting boots with Rocket Boots, so you can run fast and fly briefly.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
accessories.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.why: An extra minion slot is too important to leave on the table for this class.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.why: This station buff is one of the best pre-Hardmode power spikes available to summoner.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Defense still matters because summoner is often punished hardest for every positioning mistake.

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.why: It is a low-friction global buff that should be active basically all the time.

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.
